steps.description: Identify the exact runtime question to answer, the relevant live target, and the last stable step or checkpoint that can be trusted as the starting point.
Inspect the live runtime and gather only directly observed signals needed to answer the question, keeping raw observations separate from interpretation.

If any worker handoff or intermediate result is missing required context, either request the minimum clarification needed or perform a bounded local repair from the last stable step, then re-check the affected runtime evidence.

constraints: Prefer the smallest workflow that can finish the task.
Keep execution sequential unless clearly independent subproblems appear.
Do not guess or fill gaps from incomplete handoffs.
Use bounded repair only from the last stable step when clarification is not required.
success_criteria: The answer is grounded only in directly observed runtime evidence.
Any missing handoff context is clarified or repaired before relying on it.
Unverified or blocked areas are stated explicitly rather than inferred.
